rules.a_floor1: exclude pure-decode rows with num_seqs == 1 (CHOSEN: multi_sequence_pure_decode)
rules.a_floor5pct: exclude pure-decode rows with num_seqs < ceil(0.05*128) = 7
rules.b_tail25pct: truncate after the last row with num_seqs >= 0.25*128 = 32
rules.c_capped_tail: truncate after the last decode row with num_seqs > k, k = capped loaded outputs of the model
